translationRepairs: Xianfeng 4 (1854) Yong Fu's memorial let garrisons sell Ili and Tarbagatai stock locally and buy replacements themselves.
Xianfeng 4 (1854) Gengfu's memorial let garrisons sell Ili and Tarbagatai stock locally and buy replacements themselves.
s0080 has 用賡福請: 賡 is gēng, so the personal name is Gengfu, not Yong Fu (as if 永福). The proposed idiomatic correctly restores that reading while leaving the rest of the sentence intact.
In the fourth year of Xianfeng, following Yong Fu's request, horses at Ili and Tarbagatai were sold locally at adjusted prices and each garrison ordered to purchase on its own.
In the fourth year of Xianfeng, following Gengfu's request, horses at Ili and Tarbagatai were sold locally at adjusted prices and each garrison ordered to purchase on its own.
The same focus unit 用賡福請 requires Gengfu in the literal field as well; replacing Yong Fu with Gengfu corrects the misreading without altering the surrounding wording.
Thereafter Setsen Khan banners and others supplied horses and camels for the war effort; soon came donations of 2,100 horses and 1,200 from Xilin Gol—some accepted, some refused.
Thereafter Sain Noyan banners and others supplied horses and camels for the war effort; soon came donations of 2,100 horses and 1,200 from Xilin Gol—some accepted, some refused.
s0104 names 三音諾顏部, the Sain Noyan (Sain Noyon) Khalkha aimag, not Setsen Khan (車臣). The prior idiomatic confuses two distinct titles; Sain Noyan is the accurate replacement.

From then the Setsen Khan departments and others, for military affairs, supplied horses and camels; soon two thousand one hundred horses were donated, Xilin Gol league one thousand two hundred—some kept, some declined.

From then the Sain Noyan departments and others, for military affairs, supplied horses and camels; soon two thousand one hundred horses were donated, Xilin Gol league one thousand two hundred—some kept, some declined.
The literal must track the same 三音諾顏部. Replacing Setsen Khan with Sain Noyan restores the correct Khalkha designation named in the Chinese.
